action_items: OPTIONAL hardening: the demo asset seeder only re-seeds when the demo collection is empty (count of demo:True AND deleted_at:null > 0 => skip). If an MA-owned demo asset is soft-deleted (via /acrm/approve-delete), that specific row is not re-created on next startup, so the seeded pool can shrink below 45 over time. Consider making seed_demo_assets top-up missing titles individually instead of an all-or-nothing skip.
OPTIONAL: server.py is 1697 lines - split by domain (assets, acrm, rcg, admin/category, master data) per the >700 line guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py length still >1500 lines - suggest domain-level modularization for maintainability.
seed_demo_assets is idempotent only 'if empty' - after any approve-delete the total public count drifts down permanently unless force=True is triggered.
